message: You know, when the power goes out during a storm, it’s a great reminder that we don’t always need screens to have fun. I’ve found that the simplest things—like a deck of cards or a good book—can turn into the best entertainment. If you’re looking to prepare for stormy weather, I came across a helpful resource that gives some solid tips on getting ready. Just remember, sometimes the best memories are made when the lights go out! ☔️
